title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
abstract: arXiv:2610.36153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. translated_title: Stratum：超越上下文窗口的编码智能体仓库记忆
translated_abstract: 上下文窗口已经增长了一千倍，然而编码智能体在每次会话开始时仍然对过去的工作毫无记忆。它们会重新读取文件、重试失败的方法，并忘记几小时前已经确定的根本原因。这不是上下文长度问题，而是记忆架构问题。我们的假设是：编码智能体需要持久的、具有经验感知能力的仓库记忆，使知识能够从一个会话延续到下一个会话。在真实仓库上的三项测量结果支撑了这一设计。首先，中等规模的项目已经超过最大的生产级上下文窗口，并且将知识存储在模型的键值（KV）缓存中的字节开销，比将其存储为索引文本高出 $10^4$ 到 $10^5$ 倍。其次，在752个真实的缺陷修复提交中，修复操作的中位数只编辑两个文件，这些文件及其直接导入的内容合计不到仓库的10%；瓶颈在于选择，而非容量。第三，即使考虑传递性导入，……
tldr: 该论文提出Stratum，为编码智能体提供跨会话的持久化、经验感知的仓库记忆系统，并通过实证测量证明真正的瓶颈在于相关知识的选择而非上下文窗口容量。
